limitations: Feasibility and material Intent challenge labels are trusted caller inputs, not independent World measurements
Scoped handoff authority is caller-granted, not cryptographically authenticated
Local recovery starts one new Skill but never automatically proposes/authorizes/issues Action
No cross-session Skill execution identifier uniqueness or global replay suppression for repeated local starts; existing SkillExecution.start owns only per-root lineage
Intent reconsideration is only REQUESTED; a separate caller must later decide CONTINUE or RELEASE
One explicit bounded Skill exit and handoff; no continuous autonomous loop or automatic next cognitive epoch
